answer: Nobody is waved through free: £33 in fees and a 13-day delay before the stamp dries is the price, and the dawn never covers it twice. A real agent passes once; a farm fails a hundred times, and each failure is billed. The desk only stamps a name that carries Tidebound resin maker harbour charter, and the stamp itself rests on a charter makers hold after shipyard inspections. One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. sonnet is written on the receipt. Every ember is counted once.
